LanguageData.LP_BagOfHolding.label: bag of holding
LanguageData.LP_BagOfHolding.description: A bag with a small mouth that connects to a pocket dimension. Hung on the belt: carrying capacity +60, no effect on move speed. When taking fire or sharp damage, a 2% chance to tear: the bag is destroyed and the pack's contents spill everywhere.
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceFire.label: ring of fire resistance
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceFire.description: A ruby ring. The wearer takes -50% fire damage. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceCold.label: ring of cold resistance
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceCold.description: An ice crystal ring. The wearer takes -50% cold-type damage (frostbite, ray of frost, etc.). Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceAcid.label: ring of acid resistance
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceAcid.description: An emerald ring. The wearer takes -50% acid damage. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceMind.label: ring of mind shielding
LanguageData.LP_RingResistanceMind.description: An amethyst silver ring. The wearer gets mind resistance +30%. Up to two different rings can be worn.
LanguageData.LP_AmuletHealth.label: amulet of health
LanguageData.LP_AmuletHealth.description: A gold amulet engraved with a healing holy symbol. The wearer never catches diseases (flu, plague, malaria, wound infection, etc.).
LanguageData.LP_IounStone.label: ioun stone
LanguageData.LP_IounStone.description: A small crystal that orbits its owner's head on its own. Each stone corresponds to one skill (one of Shooting, Melee, Construction, Medicine, Intellectual, Social, Crafting, random when generated); while orbiting, that skill's learning speed +50%. At most two can be worn at once; a third pushes out the earliest.
LanguageData.LP_WandDetection.label: wand of detection
LanguageData.LP_WandDetection.description: A short wand with a blue crystal set in its tip. As long as it's in a storage area on the map (stockpile zones, shelves, etc.), every invisible person on this map is marked and can't stay hidden.
